voiceSummary: Vertoz Limited published its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026 on 15th November 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 13th November 2026. The company is primarily engaged in Trading Business. Swadeshi Industries and Leasing Limited reported a Net Profit after tax of 202.74 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Binayak Tex Processors Limited reported a Net Profit after tax of 265.15 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Vipul Organics Limited reported a Net Profit after tax of 221.57 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Vertoz Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vertoz Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 5,446.38 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 498.33 lakhs. Profit for the period was 369.80 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.43. Total assets were 14,875.50 lakhs. The auditor issued a clean review report. Consolidated results include subsidiaries such as Adzurite Solutions, Own Web Solutions, and Vertoz Inc.

attchmntText: Vertoz Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 27, 2026, titled "Vertoz Introduces AI Connectivity for Advertisers and Publishers.".
